(5) Bottom wide panel: caption 'Every check-in gets a slot on the screen.' at top left, a screen box 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12' at top right, and placeholders raman, priya, ravi in a row from left to right. pages.observation: The reading order is clear: Z-pattern left to right, top to bottom. No placeholder is covered by a caption or the sign, and none of the boxes touch. Issues: (a) 'A later morning' signals a time jump, but the page gives no reference point. I can't tell later than what, or whether this is a new day, a flash-forward or a return to the present. A setting image or a clearer marker would help. (b) The roles of Raman and Meera in panel 1 are not shown. I can't tell whether either is staff at the front desk or a patient. Meera never appears again on this page. (c) 'Some check in ahead' with only Priya shown suggests Priya used the app, but this is inferred, not stated. She has no phone cue or dialogue. (d) 'his own phone' in panel 4 correctly refers back to Ravi in panel 3, so that is fine. (e) In panel 5 the slot numbers A-10/A-11/A-12 seem to belong to raman/priya/ravi, but only because the placeholders sit in the same left-to-right order. Nothing links a slot to a person. The next page depends on Ravi being A-12, so this link should be explicit (a label, an arrow, or Ravi looking at his number). (f) The whole page is caption narration with no dialogue or reaction. It reads like an explainer, and no character shows a feeling or speaks. Consider at least one reaction or a line of dialogue. (g) Panels 1-4 have large empty lower areas, and the captions take up a large share of each panel's top. That is acceptable in a storyboard, but the art needs to fill these areas.
